market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off environment dominates. US-Iran escalation keeps oil elevated, pressuring equities and pushing yields higher. Expect volatility in energy, defense, and rate-sensitive sectors. August closed positive for stocks but September opens on geopolitical stress. Crypto and precious metals under pressure from rate-hike expectations. Watch for further Hormuz-related headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure capex cycle remains structurally intact despite near-term software earnings wobbles. GCC $2.1T capex and energy transition create multi-year investment themes. Apple's AI pivot under Ternus signals tech sector re-rating. However, sustained 5%+ yields and geopolitical fragmentation cap multiple expansion. Favor quality, cash-generative, and infrastructure-oriented equities over speculative growth.
